decision: A pass closes shared cache/model/fixed-state integration and permits design of a separate production-qualification experiment; it does not authorize a production launch.
nonclaims: Three-record overfitting is not evidence of generalization.
Exact source-product recovery is not synthesis-success probability or route certification.
No biological labels, guidance, candidate selection, or sealed holdouts are used.
The bounded gate does not authorize production multi-reaction training or sampling.
